name: Swinburne Indigenous Relocation Scholarship (VET)
summary: A one-off $2,500 for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students relocating to start a Swinburne diploma or advanced diploma.
key: Valued at $2,500 as a one-off payment.
who: Australian citizen of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander heritage
Commencing first-year full-time Swinburne diploma (including UniLink) or advanced diploma student in 2026
Selection considers hardship and regional, rural or remote origin
how: Online application with personal statement, proof of heritage and one reference
Connect with an Indigenous Student Advisor at the Moondani Toombadool Centre

evidence.quote: be of Australian Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander heritage
